例句

  1. “What do you think of our new teacher?” “There is something about her that attracts me.”
    「你覺得我們的新老師怎麼樣？」「她身上有某種吸引我的特質。」
  2. I want a phone that takes good pictures.
    我想要一支拍照很好看的手機。
  3. Tom has a dog that can swim.
    Tom 有一隻會游泳的狗。
  4. This is the train that goes to Osaka.
    這是去大阪的火車。
  5. I like movies that make me laugh.
    我喜歡能讓我笑的電影。
  6. Do you know the girl that won the speech contest?
    你認識贏得演講比賽的那個女孩嗎？
  7. We need a room that has two beds.
    我們需要一間有兩張床的房間。
  8. There is something about his voice that makes people listen.
    他的聲音有某種讓人想聽的地方。
  9. There was something about the old man that reminded me of my grandfather.
    那位老先生有某種讓我想起我爺爺的地方。
  10. There is something about Kyoto that brings me back every year.
    京都有某種讓我每年都回去的地方。
  11. There is something about the new teacher that makes students want to study.
    新老師有某種讓學生想讀書的地方。
  12. There is something about rainy days that makes me sleepy.
    雨天有某種讓我想睡的東西。
  13. The thing that attracts me to Japan is its food.
    日本吸引我的是它的食物。
  14. Everyone likes people that tell funny stories.
    每個人都喜歡會講好笑故事的人。
  15. There is something about this song that makes me cry.
    這首歌有某種讓我想哭的地方。
  16. I bought a bag that was on sale.
    我買了一個在特價的包包。
  17. There is something about the sea that calms me down.
    大海有某種讓我平靜下來的東西。
  18. This is a book that changed my life.
    這是一本改變我人生的書。
  19. The bus that stops here goes to the airport.
    停在這裡的公車開往機場。
  20. I have a friend that lives in Canada.
    我有一個住在加拿大的朋友。
  21. The shop that sells the best bread is near my school.
    賣最好吃麵包的店在我學校附近。
  22. Is there a bus that goes to the zoo?
    有開往動物園的公車嗎？
  23. The students that sit in the back can't see the board.
    坐在後面的學生看不到黑板。
  24. Ann wrote a song that won a prize.
    Ann 寫了一首得獎的歌。
  25. The man that lives next door is a doctor.
    住在隔壁的男人是醫生。
  26. We stayed at a hotel that had a big pool.
    我們住在一家有大游泳池的飯店。
  27. Things that are free are not always good.
    免費的東西不一定好。
  28. What's the name of the river that runs through Tokyo?
    流經東京的那條河叫什麼名字？
  29. Our team needs a player that can run fast.
    我們隊需要一個跑得快的球員。
  30. Children that read a lot often write well.
    讀很多書的孩子常常寫得很好。
  31. I have an aunt who works at the airport.
    我有一個在機場工作的阿姨。
  32. The boy who won the race is my cousin.
    贏得賽跑的那個男孩是我表弟。
  33. This is the road which goes to the beach.
    這是通往海邊的路。
  34. We visited a museum which has many old toys.
    我們參觀了一間有很多老玩具的博物館。
  35. What do you think of this dress?
    你覺得這件洋裝怎麼樣？
  36. What did you think of the movie?
    你覺得那部電影怎麼樣？
  37. What do your parents think of your boyfriend?
    你爸媽覺得你男朋友怎麼樣？
  38. What do you think about my idea?
    你覺得我的想法怎麼樣？
  39. What do you think about the new school rule?
    你覺得新的校規怎麼樣？
  40. What did Tom think of your new haircut?
    Tom 覺得你的新髮型怎麼樣？
  41. I just finished this drawing. What do you think of it?
    我剛畫完這張畫。你覺得它怎麼樣？
  42. Ken is our new captain. What do you think of him?
    Ken 是我們的新隊長。你覺得他怎麼樣？
